thread:
aj: Uploaded an updated Notify Grid + suppression flow — small iteration focusing on compactness and keyboard flow. Mock: https://framer.mock/redwood/notify-grid. Would love quick UX/a11y eyes.

mira: Quick pass: the grid is tighter which is good, but the channel labels feel truncated at tablet widths. Can we let labels wrap and show full name on hover?

devon: Wrapping is fine but ensure the backend canonical channel id is visible somewhere (tooltip or small muted text). Engineers need that for incident runbooks.

samira: Keyboard/a11y: the severity chips are not reachable via arrow keys, only tab. For grids with toggles it's better UX to support arrow navigation inside the grid and tab to jump between interactive groups.

aj: I can add roving tabindex for the grid cells. Plan: arrow keys move between severity toggles within the same row, tab moves out of the row. Thoughts?

mira: Roving tabindex + role="grid" sounds good. Also, add instructions in an offscreen helper: "Use arrow keys to move between severities".

samira: Visual: the focus ring on the chips is subtle; increase contrast on the focus outline color. Also, the suppression modal close button lacks an aria-label.

devon: On suppression, prefer offering both a duration shorthand (e.g., "4h") and a calendar picker for absolute end. Avoid cron strings; they're confusing for most users.

aj: Updated: removed cron mode, added duration + absolute toggle. Also added presets: 30m, 2h, 12h, until 9am next day.

mira: Can the presets indicate scope? e.g., a small tag: "Global" or "Channel: PagerDuty". Right now it's unclear whether presets apply per-channel or globally.

samira: Also suggest showing an effective timeline bar in the summary row when a suppression is active: a tiny progress bar with tooltip showing end time. Good for quick glance.

devon: Edge case: overlapping suppressions (global + per-channel). Show a stacked badge list with effective end time computed and a help icon to explain precedence: channel-level > global-level.

aj: Will surface precedence in the UI and in a hover tooltip explaining resolution rules.

mira: Copy nits: the matrix header currently reads "Severity" — change to "Incident severity" to be explicit. Also change the preview heading from "Toast" to "Notification preview".

samira: Preview content: include sample runtime tokens ({{alert.name}}, {{severity}}, {{rule_url}}) so users can verify templates. And add a toggle to switch between plaintext and rich render.

devon: One more backend mapping: the UI lets users mute a severity for a channel, but our policy model stores allow/deny lists. Confirm non-linear mapping or we'll need a transform layer. I'll sync with aj after this thread.

aj: Noted. Accessibility follow-ups: I'll add aria-row/col indices, aria-labels on action buttons, and ensure the suppression confirm button reads the chosen end time aloud via aria-live.

mira: Microcopy: Replace "Mute" with "Pause notifications" in CTAs; more user-friendly.

samira: Also add small helper text under the suppression input: "Pauses routed notifications; does not silence alerts in the incidents list." Lots of users conflate notification pause with incident suppression.

aj: Good distinction — will add that copy. Action items: aj iterate mock + update tokens; devon verify policy mapping; samira to re-review ARIA attributes; mira to check label wrapping animations. Back with updates by Thu EOD.

deploy-bot: Heads up: design review with Eng moved to Thu 10:30 AM. Calendar updated.

mira: Thanks — adding the updated mock to the review deck now. :rocket:
